sn17.9:1.3: Upari bhikkhave ākāse verambā nāma vātā vāyanti || ||
sn17.9:1.4: Tattha yo pakkhī gacchati tam enaṃ verambā vātā khipanti ||
sn17.9:1.5: tassa verambavātakhittassa aññeneva pādā gacchanti aññena pakkhā gacchanti || aññena sisaṃ gacchati aññena kāyo gacchati || || 4
sn17.9:1.6: Evam eva kho bhikkhave idhekacco bhikkhu lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūto pariyādiṇṇacitto pubbaṇhasamayam nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya gāmaṃ nigamam vā piṇḍāya pavisati arakkhitena kāyena arakkhitena vācāya arakkhitena cittena anupaṭṭhitāya satiyā asaṃvutehi indriyehi || || 5
sn17.9:1.7: So tattha passati mātugāmam dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā ||
sn17.9:1.8: tassa mātugāmam disvā dunnivattham vā duppārutam vā rāgo cittam anuddhaṃseti || ||
sn17.9:1.9: So rāgānuddhaṃsitena cittena sikkham paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati ||
sn17.9:1.10: tassa aññe cīvaraṃ haranti aññe pattaṃ haranti aññe nisīdanaṃ haranti aññe sucigharaṃ haranti || verambavātakhittassa va sakuṇassa || || 6
sn17.9:1.11: Evaṃ dāruṇo kho bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe || || 7
